text:
ravi-fin: FYI batch billing for PulseLabs went out at 08:05 — 3 of their corporate cards declined (3/9). Processor response: `DO_NOT_HONOR`. No network errors. Need quick plan: retries, comms, and whether to enable temporary payment terms.

jamie-payments: Can you list last4 and payment IDs? I want to see if declines are across different BINs or same issuer.

ravi-fin: last4: 1115, 3322, 9900. payment ids pay_b7c2..., pay_b7c2..., pay_b7c2... (DMing full IDs).

billing-bot: [system] payment.failed events=3 reason=card_decline code=DO_NOT_HONOR.

alyssa-support: Customer ticket popped: "We saw charges attempted this morning. Please hold — we'll provide a preferred card." They asked if we can accept ACH instead.

jamie-payments: Proposal: 1) Stop automated retries for those specific payment tokens. 2) Offer invoice link + ACH microdeposit setup. 3) If customer requests, grant one-time Net-30 on this invoice up to $10k while ACH clears. 4) Log decision in billing notes.

kevin-ops: +1 on Net-30 up to $10k. Add `temp_terms: net30_10k` to account metadata and notify collections if not paid by day 31.

maria-legal: okay to offer net terms short-term, but do not promise extended credit beyond approval. Keep language: "we can place this invoice on temporary 30-day payment terms while payment is arranged." Also: do not collect/store full PAN in support.

ravi-fin: Draft message to send to customer:

"Hi PulseLabs — we attempted your scheduled invoice but three cards were declined by the issuing bank; no funds were captured. We can pause retries and: a) send an invoice link and ACH instructions (microdeposit verification) or b) retry with a different card if you share one. If you prefer, we can temporarily place this invoice on 30-day terms while ACH clears. Please reply with which you prefer.

If we don't receive a response in 3 business days we'll follow standard follow-up.

— Redwood Billing"

alyssa-support: I'll send that and ask if they'd like the ACH setup link.

jamie-payments: I'll pause retries. If they pick ACH, I'll start the microdeposit flow and not attempt any further card retries. Microdeposit flow command:

```
/payments microdeposit --account_id acct_pulse --amounts 0.12,0.22 --expiry 7d
```

billing-bot: [system] invoice.link created: https://redwood-invoices/local/ln_pulse-55 (expires 7d).

alyssa-support: Sent message in ticket #4680 asking preference and included invoice link. Customer replied: "Send ACH details and we'll start microdeposits."

jamie-payments: Starting microdeposit flow and cancelling scheduled retries. Marking payment tokens with `awaiting_ach` tag.

ravi-fin: Added billing note: "Temp net30 up to $10k approved by kevin-ops; ACH flow started; retries stopped."

maria-legal: Reminder: store only verification status in Zendesk (verified/pending), do not post amounts or bank account numbers in Slack. If they send bank info via email, forward to secure intake form.

kevin-ops: I'll set a reminder to review account at day 25. If ACH hasn't cleared, collections notice at day 31.

billing-bot: [system] microdeposit.initiated account=acct_pulse status=pending verify_url=https://redwood-payments/verify/mt_3321 (expires in 7 days).

alyssa-support: Ticket updated: customer opted ACH, microdeposit link sent, net-30 terms noted. They said "thanks". :white_check_mark:

ravi-fin: Closing thread — status: retries cancelled, ACH microdeposits initiated, invoice link created, temporary net-30 approved. Will update when verification completes or if charge needs escalation.
